story.tasks: - Task 1: Verify existing test file and coverage (AC: 1, 7) - Locate test_bronze_io_manager_unit.py in tests/resources/ - Run pytest on existing tests to verify current state - Identify coverage gaps against acceptance criteria - Document which ACs are already covered - Task 2: Add missing error handling tests (AC: 6) - Add test for invalid data type (e.g., passing dict instead of list for links) - Add test for malformed HTML data (missing required url field) - Add test for invalid JSON during deserialization - Add test for TypeError when unknown object type passed to handle_output - Task 3: Enhance existing tests if needed (AC: 2, 3, 4, 5) - Review test_link_list_serialization_round_trip for completeness - Review test_html_content_storage_with_metadata for all metadata fields - Verify test_sha256_hash_generation_consistency validates full 64-char hash - Verify test_created_at_timestamp_format validates ISO 8601 format - Task 4: Add load_input tests (AC: 2, 3) - Add test for loading link list from bronze layer - Add test for loading HTML content from bronze layer - Add test for handling corrupted JSON files gracefully - Add test for handling missing upstream output context - Task 5: Run full test suite and verify (AC: 7) - Run `uv run pytest tests/resources/test_bronze_io_manager_unit.py -v` - Verify all tests pass - Check test coverage with pytest-cov if available - Ensure test markers (@pytest.mark.integration) are correctly applied - Task 6: Run quality checks (AC: 7) - Run `make check` to verify format, lint, typecheck - Fix any ruff violations in test file - Ensure tests follow project conventions (no doc-strings per CLAUDE.md)

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: AC1: Unit test file created: `tests/resources/test_bronze_io_manager.py` (or test_bronze_io_manager_unit.py) - File exists at expected path AC2: Tests verify link list serialization/deserialization - Link list round-trip tests pass AC3: Tests verify raw HTML storage with metadata - HTML storage tests pass AC4: Tests verify full SHA256 hash filename generation - Hash generation tests verify 64-character length AC5: Tests verify timestamp creation - Timestamp format tests pass with ISO 8601 validation AC6: Tests verify error handling for invalid data - Error handling tests cover type errors and missing fields AC7: All tests pass - pytest run succeeds for all BronzeIOManager tests

docs.doc: Unit test files required for BronzeIOManager and SilverIOManager with comprehensive tests verifying serialization, deserialization, hash generation, timestamp creation, and error handling.
BronzeIOManager handles serialization/deserialization of link lists and raw HTML. All bronze artifacts use full SHA256 hash filenames and include created_at timestamp field.

Bronze Layer stores raw, immutable data exactly as ingested. Location: artifacts/bronze/ with subdirectories raw_links/ and raw_html/. Characteristics: immutable (write-once), full fidelity preservation, enables reprocessing without re-downloading.

Integration tests only, ensuring folder structure mirrors code organization. Test path has relation to module/file being tested. No doc-strings per project standards. Run make check after significant changes.
Use pytest via uv run pytest. Dagster development server provides asset and job execution context.

package.name: dagster
package.usage: Provides IOManager, OutputContext, InputContext, AssetKey test utilities

story-context.constraints: - Test file must be located at tests/resources/test_bronze_io_manager_unit.py (mirrors dagster_project/resources/io_managers.py) - All tests must use @pytest.mark.integration decorator - No doc-strings allowed (per CLAUDE.md constitution) - No __init__.py files in test directories - Use tmp_path fixture for isolated file operations - Use Dagster test utilities: OutputContext, InputContext, AssetKey - Tests must verify full 64-character SHA256 hashes (not truncated) - Timestamps must be validated as ISO 8601 format - Error handling tests required for: TypeError (invalid types), JSONDecodeError (corrupted files), missing required fields - Run 'make check' after changes to verify ruff compliance - Follow idiomatic Python approaches only

interface.name: BronzeIOManager.handle_output
interface.signature: def handle_output(self, context: OutputContext, obj: Any) -> None

interfaces.interface: Routes output based on type: list → link_list, dict with html_content → html. Raises TypeError for unknown types.
Routes input based on asset_key: 'raw_links' → link_list, 'raw_html' → html. Raises TypeError for unknown asset types.

interface.name: BronzeIOManager._handle_output_link_list
interface.signature: def _handle_output_link_list(self, context: OutputContext, link_list: list) -> None

interfaces.interface: Saves link list with metadata: {links, created_at, link_count}. Uses SHA256 hash of sorted concatenated links as filename.

interface.name: BronzeIOManager._handle_output_html
interface.signature: def _handle_output_html(self, context: OutputContext, html_data: dict) -> None

interfaces.interface: Saves HTML with metadata: {url, content, created_at, content_length, download_info}. Uses SHA256 hash of URL as filename.
Loads latest link list from bronze layer. Returns empty list on errors. Catches JSONDecodeError and FileNotFoundError.
Loads latest HTML content from bronze layer. Returns empty dict on errors. Catches JSONDecodeError and FileNotFoundError.

tests.standards: Testing framework: pytest with integration markers (@pytest.mark.integration). Test structure mirrors production code organization (tests/resources/ mirrors dagster_project/resources/). Use tmp_path fixtures for isolated file operations. Dagster provides test utilities: OutputContext, InputContext, AssetKey for testing IOManager implementations. No doc-strings in tests per project constitution. Run 'make check' after changes to verify ruff compliance (format, lint, typecheck). Test markers configured in pyproject.toml: contract, integration, unit.
tests.locations: tests/resources/test_bronze_io_manager_unit.py - Unit tests for BronzeIOManager tests/integration/test_bronze_io_manager.py - Integration tests (if exists) tests/integration/test_pipeline_integration.py - End-to-end pipeline tests
